text:
incident-bot: RED ALERT: serving-runtime crashloop spike detected in us-west1 (model-pool-gpu). 75% of requests are hitting 5xx or timeouts. Auto-scaler activity: rapid scale-up/down observed. Paging oncall.
alice.m: I'm paged, looking now. Thanks for the alert. Can someone post the top error lines?
ben: seeing a lot of `OOMKilled` and `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in container logs for model-worker-*. Logs:
ben: ```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z model-worker-9 OOMKilled: runtime: out of memory
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z model-worker-23 Terminated with signal 9
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z model-worker-23 cuda: failed to allocate: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
2026-03-15T03:12:13Z kubelet: CrashLoopBackOff: back-off 5s
``` 
carla: cluster-autoscaler logs show rapid add/remove events, nodes flapping between Ready and NotReady. Looks like scale-down is aggressively removing nodes that still have cached KV shards -> causes cold restarts and OOMs when workers try to reload.
carla: ```
I0315 03:10:00 cluster-autoscaler: Scale up: group gpu-pool 3->6
I0315 03:11:20 cluster-autoscaler: Scale down: removing node gpu-7
I0315 03:12:05 cluster-autoscaler: Scale up: group gpu-pool 4->7
``` 
alice.m: Customer impact: A/B routes report 40-80s tail latency and ~6% 5xx for premium tier. Not yet full outage but clear brownout. Which mitigations can we try immediately?
ben: Immediate options:
- pin critical model replicas to stable nodepool (set nodeSelector to gpu-stable-1)
- cordon/drain the noisy nodes to stop churn
- temporarily increase min nodes in GPU nodepool to avoid scale-down
- reduce HPA aggressiveness: increase stabilizationWindowSeconds, scaleDownDelay
- route traffic to fallback quantized model or CPU-safe variant
carla: DO NOT restart the whole pool; restarting causes mass cold load and more OOMs. We should prefer draining flapping nodes and increasing min size.
infra-bot: automated mitigation suggestion: increase nodepool min size by +2, set cluster-autoscaler --scale-down-unneeded-time from 10m to 30m for gpu-pool.
alice.m: I'm going to pin the top 3 critical pods to gpu-stable-1 and increase min nodes. @carla can you cordon the most flappy nodes? @dmitri please prepare fallback route.
carla: cordoning gpu-7 and gpu-9 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-7; kubectl drain gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` (draining low-priority pods only)
carla: cordon done for gpu-7, draining in progress, moving cache shards off.
ben: bumping nodepool min nodes: `gcloud container node-pools update gpu-pool --min-nodes=6 --region=us-west1` (submitted)
ben: also adding autoscaler flags: set --scale-down-unneeded-time=30m and --balance-similar-node-groups=false for now (will push change and monitor)
dmitri: routing change ready: reroute 25% of premium traffic to quantized-ggml-small via routing rule `route-fallback: quantized-ggml-small 25%` — deploying in 30s
alice.m: Good. Also temporarily disable burst capacity for this pool to avoid rapid add/remove. Anyone got objections? 
carla: no objections. Doing that now: disabling burst in autoscaler config for gpu-pool.
infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler flags updated (rolling config). Expect changes within 90s.
ben: watching metrics: node churn decreasing; number of OOMs dropping but still a few crashloops as draining completes.
ben: small fix: lowered model batch size on live config to reduce memory pressure: `BATCH_SIZE=4 -> 2` for model-pool-gpu. Patching deployment.
alice.m: Customer comms: opening a quick incident note, tagging affected customers. Status: partial brownout, mitigation in progress, ETA 15-30m for stabilization.
oncall-rotation: handing off to night oncall @dmitri in 20m. Please confirm you have context.
dmitri: I have context, will take over once alice signs off. Plan: keep min nodes raised, keep quantized fallback live at 25%, monitor 5xx and tail-p99. If crashloops persist, we'll pin more pods and consider switching traffic regionally to eu-west1.
carla: note: one pod showed `cuda: illegal memory access` which sometimes points to GPU driver mismatch after node restart. We're verifying GPU driver versions across the pool and will avoid mass reboots.
ben: quick note on long-term fix: we need to tune autoscaler stabilization windows for GPU nodepools and add conservative thresholds for eviction of nodes hosting large memory-backed caches. Also consider adding a warm pool of pre-warmed nodes for model hotstart.
alice.m: All right, handing to dmitri. Final status before handoff: min nodes increased, autoscaler scale-down delayed to 30m, burst disabled, 25% traffic on quantized fallback, cordoned/ drained two flappy nodes. Observed 5xx down from 6% -> 2.2% in last 5m. Still monitoring.
dmitri: taking over. If anyone gets a page, escalate to infra-ops with `pager rotation` tag. I'll post updates in thread. Thanks.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: severity reduced to P2. Ongoing mitigation. Runbook: Serving-runtime crashloop -> follow gpu-autoscale-thrash checklist.
alice.m: thx team, leaving notes in postmortem template. I'll draft RCA after stabilizes. :white_check_mark:
